process_control.criterion: treated until quantitative conversion into the thermodynamically stable crystal modification; no analytical method is recited

procedure_text:
8. 8.	Verfahren zur Herstellung der thermodynamisch stabilen Kristallmodifikation gemäß Anspruch 1, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass man
a) eine metastabile Kristallmodifikation oder ein Gemisch der metastabilen Kristallmodifikationen von Tembotrione in Lösungsmitteln suspendiert und/oder löst und
b) bis zur quantitativen Umwandlung in die thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation bei Temperaturen von 0°C bis 80°C behandelt.
9. 9.	Verfahren gemäß Anspruch 8, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass als Lösungsmittel Alkohole oder Ketone verwendet werden.
procedure_summary: A metastable crystal modification of tembotrione, or a mixture of the metastable modifications, is suspended and/or dissolved in solvents and treated at moderate temperature until conversion into the thermodynamically stable crystal modification is quantitative. The dependent claim restricts the solvent to alcohols or ketones.
notes: Claims 8 and 9, the solvent process. THIS IS NOT NEW CHEMISTRY: it is the SAME transformation already recorded as Preparation - General Process_Step 1, recited as a claim. A consumer must count the document as disclosing TWO transformations in total, not four: Claims_Step 1 duplicates Preparation - General Process_Step 1, and Claims_Step 2 duplicates Preparation - General Process_Step 2. Both pairs are the same disclosure in two places. The step count of 2 for this section matches A0's estimate of 2, which follows the reference run's convention of counting recited process claims. reaction_class recrystallisation, for the same reason as in the general process: dissolution and/or suspension in a solvent, then crystallisation of a different solid form of the same molecule. No bond is formed or broken. GENERIC MATERIAL, and this is a deliberate departure from A1. Claim 8 recites eine metastabile Kristallmodifikation oder ein Gemisch der metastabilen Kristallmodifikationen von Tembotrione. It names NEITHER modification II NOR modification III, and [0008] at line 73 says tembotrione occurs in mindestens zwei metastable modifications, so the claim is genuinely broader than II plus III: it reads on any metastable form, including one this document never characterises. The reactant is therefore carried as the unnumbered identifier tembotrione metastable crystal modification, exactly the specificity claim 8 has, and modifications II and III are NOT asserted as reactants here. The alternative, keeping II and III and flagging the mismatch, was rejected because the structured fields would still assert a narrower claim than the patent makes, and a consumer reading the fields rather than this prose would get the wrong scope. It matters downstream: the pathways pass builds its key starting material from reactant_names. A1 recorded no such generic identifier for this section, so a1_missing_compound is raised per rule 7 and is_complete is false. That flag is the honest signal here: it is A1 that narrowed the claim, and the flag is what will show an auditor where to look. Where the document does recite the metastable forms by number is the description, and the Preparation - General Process records carry them by number accordingly. GENERIC SOLVENT: claim 9 recites only the bare classes Alkohole oder Ketone and names no specific solvent, so compounds[] carries NO solvent entry. Inventing methanol or acetone here from [0023] would put a solvent in a claim that does not recite one. The two classes are carried as solvent_class tags instead. a1_missing_compound is NOT raised: a compound class is not a compound, so there is nothing A1 could have missed. The a) and b) lettering of claim 8 is not two transformations: a) suspends or dissolves and b) holds until conversion, which are two stages of one conversion. is_one_pot is false, as it is everywhere in this patent. The bare tembotrione record A1 wrote for this section is deliberately absent from both claims records: it belongs to the product claims, claim 1 naming the compound whose crystal modification is claimed, and neither process claim recites tembotrione as such as a charged material. Leaving it out is a choice, not an oversight. No charge, no yield, no purity, no time and no workup is recited, as is normal for a process claim; per the reference run's convention that absence is not flagged for a claims section.

pressure.qualitative_text: unter hohem Druck, mindestens 5 bar (under high pressure, at least 5 bar); a stated minimum, not a set point

procedure_text: 10. 10.	Verfahren zur Herstellung der thermodynamisch stabilen Kristallmodifikation gemäß Anspruch 1, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass man eine metastabile Kristallmodifikation oder ein Gemisch der metastabilen Kristallmodifikationen von Tembotrione unter hohem Druck, mindestens 5 bar, mahlt.
procedure_summary: A metastable crystal modification of tembotrione, or a mixture of the metastable modifications, is milled under high pressure to give the thermodynamically stable crystal modification.
notes: Claim 10, the grinding process. THIS IS NOT NEW CHEMISTRY: it is the SAME transformation already recorded as Preparation - General Process_Step 2, recited as a claim. Counted once at document level, not twice. reaction_class other, for the same reason as there: a solid-state conversion by milling, with nothing dissolved and nothing crystallised from solution, and no enum value covering it. PRESSURE: unter hohem Druck, mindestens 5 bar, a stated minimum. The printed wording is kept in pressure.qualitative_text and value_kpa carries the same figure in the unit the field is defined in. Same generic material as claim 8, and handled the same way: claim 10 recites eine metastabile Kristallmodifikation oder ein Gemisch der metastabilen Kristallmodifikationen von Tembotrione and names neither II nor III, and [0008] at line 73 puts the number of metastable forms at mindestens zwei, so the claim reads on metastable forms this document never characterises. The reactant is the unnumbered identifier tembotrione metastable crystal modification, which A1 did not record for this section, so a1_missing_compound is raised per rule 7 and is_complete is false. The numbered modifications are asserted only where the document numbers them, on the Preparation - General Process records. No solvent, no temperature, no time, no charge, no yield and no workup is recited. The only decimal comma in this section is the melting point 124,0°C in claim 7, which belongs to a product claim, not to either process claim, and so appears in neither record.
